{{Quote|Lando Calrissian is the galaxy's smoothest, most notorious scoundrel, and he'll return in a brand-new event series for Disney+. Justin Simien, creator of the critically acclaimed and hugely popular, ''Dear White People'', is developing the story with us now. A massive ''Star Wars'' fan himself, Justin has put together a reel to give you a sense of the style, tone, and irresistible swagger of our upcoming series, ''Lando''.|President [[Kathleen Kennedy]] announces ''Star Wars: Lando''|<ref name="Investor2020">{{DisneyCompany|url=disney-investor-day-2020|text=Disney Investor Day 2020}}</ref>}}
'''''Lando''''', marketed as '''''Star Wars: Lando''''', is an upcoming film. It will focus on [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]]. The story will be developed<ref name="Announcement" /> by Lando actor [[Donald Glover]] and his brother [[Stephen Glover]].<ref name="ATL" /> Announced on [[December 10]], [[2020]], the project was originally planned to be a series on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Announcement" /> before being pivoted to a movie format.<ref name="VarietyLando">{{WebCite|url=https://variety.com/2023/film/news/lando-movie-donald-glover-star-wars-1235723736|text=Donald Glover's 'Star Wars' Series 'Lando' Is Now a Movie|author=Zack Sharf|date=2023-09-14|work=[[Wikipedia:Variety (magazine)|''Variety'']]|archivedate=20230914165443}}</ref>

==Publisher's summary==
''Everyone's favorite scoundrel Lando Calrissian will return in a brand-new event series for Disney+. Justin Simien, creator of the critically-acclaimed ''Dear White People'' and a huge ''Star Wars'' fan, is developing the story.''<ref name="Announcement" />

==Development==
On [[December 10]], [[2020]], [[Lucasfilm]] announced that a ''[[Star Wars]]'' series centering on [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian]] was in development for [[Disney+]], with [[Justin Simien]] writing and serving as showrunner.<ref name="Announcement" /> On [[May 26]], [[2022]], during an interview with [[Wikipedia:Future plc#Brands|''Cinemablend'']] at [[Celebration Anaheim (2022)|Celebration Anaheim]], [[Kathleen Kennedy]] said that there was no movement on the series, and they were waiting for [[Donald Glover]] to finish other projects first.<ref name="Cinemablend">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cinemablend.com/interviews/whats-happening-with-star-wars-lando-calrissian-series-kathleen-kennedy-provides-an-update|text=What's Happening With Star Wars' Lando Calrissian Series? Kathleen Kennedy Provides An Update|work=[[Wikipedia:Future plc#Brands|''Cinemablend'']]|archivedate=20250112183439}}</ref> On [[July 18]], [[2023]], ''The Direct'' published an interview with Simien, in which he revealed he had not received any updates about the series since 2020. He stated "I have no idea what's going on" with the series.<ref name="The Direct">{{WebCite|url=https://thedirect.com/article/is-disneys-lando-show-still-happening-star-wars-writer-gives-update-exclusive|text=Is Disney+'s Lando Show Still Happening? Star Wars Writer Justin Simien Gives Update (Exclusive)|date=2023-07-18|work=[https://thedirect.com ''The Direct'']|archivedate=20230728213708}}</ref>

On [[July 27]], 2023, it was reported that Simien had exited the project due to his commitments with ''[[Wikipedia:Haunted Mansion (2023 film)|Haunted Mansion]]'', and that Donald Glover and his brother [[Stephen Glover]] would write and serve as showrunners for the series, with Glover reprising his role as Lando.<ref name="ATL" /> In an interview published earlier the same day, Simien had told ''[[Wikipedia:The Hollywood Reporter|The Hollywood Reporter]]'' that he was "still attached, I think" to the series. He stated he had been told the higher ups "loved" what he wrote, but they had needed to halt production as they worked on availability. However, he did ponder if he had been quietly fired, asking "Am I too Black? Am I too queer? And people just don't want to say that?"<ref name="THRSimien">{{WebCite|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-features/justin-simien-haunted-mansion-actors-strike-1235544639|text="To Be in Hollywood Is to Be Gaslit": Justin Simien Levels Up With Disney's 'Haunted Mansion' at a Fraught Time|date=2023-07-27|work=[[Wikipedia:The Hollywood Reporter|''The Hollywood Reporter'']]|archivedate=20230730165350}}</ref>

On [[September 14]], 2023, Lucasfilm confirmed that the project had officially shifted development into a film, rather than a television series. Stephen Glover had previously stated that its status as a film, rather than a series, was in discussion.<ref name="VarietyLando" /> On [[February 7]], [[2024]], Donald Glover stated that taking on ''Lando'' was not an "easy yes," and that he had done so due to liking the characters and his children's love for ''Star Wars''. He also stated that he felt the degree of creative control that he had allowed for a more "singular" vision for the film, which he believed would make it more desirable for audiences.<ref name="THRGlover">{{WebCite|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-features/donald-glover-maya-erskine-interview-marriage-mr-and-mrs-smith-1235817327|text=Donald Glover and Maya Erskine on Real-Life Marriage, Professional Divorce and When to Walk Away|author=Lacey Rose|date=2024-02-07|work=[[Wikipedia:The Hollywood Reporter|''The Hollywood Reporter'']]|archivedate=20240222151318}}</ref> On [[August 2]], 2024, Simien reflected on his time with the project in an interview with [[Wikipedia:Collider (website)|''Collider'']], stating that the iteration involving him had been shelved; however, he also mentioned that he had not been directly informed of such a decision.<ref name="Grieving">{{WebCite|url=https://collider.com/star-wars-lando-series-justin-simien|text=Justin Simien Admits "Grieving" Over Abandoned 'Star Wars: Lando' Series|author=Chris McPherson|date=2024-08-02|work=[[Wikipedia:Collider (website)|''Collider'']]|archivedate=20240803083844}}</ref>

On [[September 12]], 2024, Donald Glover stated that he hopes that everyone can enjoy his film, saying that he wants it to be more fun and less serious than other ''Star Wars'' movies.<ref name="DG">{{YouTube|video=B5N0vYOTMM4|text=Why Donald Glover Is Retiring Childish Gambino and More | The One|channel=@wsjstyle|name=[[Wikipedia:The Wall Street Journal|WSJ. Style]]|date=2024-09-12}}</ref> Retiring Lucasfilm President [[Kathleen Kennedy]] said that the film is "still somewhat alive" as of [[2026]] and that its fate would be up to her successors. No matter the case, she confirmed that Glover had submitted a script.<ref name="Deadline Kennedy">{{WebCite|url=https://deadline.com/2026/01/kathleen-kennedy-exit-interview-1236665253/|text=A Shift In The Force For Lucasfilm’s Kathleen Kennedy: The Exit Interview|author=Mike Flemming Jr.|date=2026-01-15|work=[[Wikipedia:Deadline Hollywood|''Deadline'']]|archivedate=20260115233219}}</ref>
